name: eSemnBun
subtitle: Sign with your electronic ID
shortDescription: Sign and verify documents with the Moldovan electronic identity card.
description: Sign PDF documents and files with the certificate on your Moldovan electronic identity card. Connect a compatible reader, choose the card and documents, then approve each signing request. Verify PAdES and XAdES signatures and share signed documents. Your private key stays on the card; a failed PIN is never retried automatically. Public timestamp and certificate-status services require an internet connection. Available features depend on the platform and reader.
releaseNotes: Horizontal card selection, adaptive layouts and native preferences.
